The question's discriminator now names the four steps and the samples: (1) with node 3 leading, append and decide a handful of entries while node 2 is blocked, so node 2 never receives the Decide and its own decided index stays low; (2) compact on node 1 or node 3 - a trim(None) on the leader, or a snapshot with local_only = false - so that replica's compacted index sits above node 2's decided index while remaining at or below its own; (3) unblock node 2 and let it win the election with try_become_leader, so its Prepare carries its own lower decided and accepted index to both peers; (4) sample each peer's compacted index, accepted index and decided index at that moment and whether its Promise was built and sent, with the panic reported through the harness's guard if the storage read goes below the trimmed index - then repeat the same four steps with the snapshot-capable entry type as the control, where the Promise should instead take the Complete-snapshot branch. That makes the decisive observation and the negative control explicit for whoever continues, and it keeps the question's conclusion and defect claim as unresolved, which is what the evidence supports. No other record changed and no execution was requested.

investigations.discriminator: A four-step run, with the snapshot-capable entry type repeated as the control. (1) With node 3 leading, append and decide several entries while node 2 is blocked, so node 2 never sees the Decide messages and keeps a lower decided index. (2) Compact on node 1 or node 3 - trim(None) on the leader, or snapshot(Some(decided), false) - so that replica's compacted index lies above node 2's decided index while staying within its own. (3) Unblock node 2 and let it win the election with try_become_leader, so its Prepare carries its own lower decided and accepted index to both peers. (4) Sample every peer's compacted, accepted and decided index at that moment and whether its Promise was built and sent, with any panic reported as an event field through the harness's guard. The decisive observation is whether a peer whose compacted index exceeds the numbers in the Prepare has its Promise built, and the control is the same four steps with a snapshot-capable entry type, where the Promise should instead take the Complete-snapshot branch and so should not abort.
